description: This file defines a command-line subcommand 'TestHookCommand' for testing hooks by sending text through a configured hook. It uses the Commander library for command-line argument parsing and interacts with external modules 'Swabble' for loading configuration and executing hooks.

classes.name: TestHookCommand
classes.description: A command-line command for testing hooks, accepting text and optional configuration path, and executing the hook asynchronously.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Asynchronously loads configuration, initializes a hook executor, and runs the hook with the provided text and timestamp.
